llm_configuration.tone: Professional, humanized engineering tone without emojis

responsible_ai_measures.hallucination_prevention: Model is explicitly instructed to decline answering if information is not found in retrieved context.
responsible_ai_measures.page_level_citations: Every returned fact must reference the exact document page number.
responsible_ai_measures.data_privacy: Documents and vector embeddings are stored locally; only retrieved context chunks are transmitted to the inference engine.
